explanation.headline: Ephedrine sulfate is not on FDA's shortage list; supply traces to a registered plant last inspected VAI 2024-07-25

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include ephedrine sulfate as of 2026-10-21.
Both Corvale sites use product labeled by Gland Pharma Limited (NDC 68083061010).
The registered manufacturing plant is Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3002647489) in India.
FDA's most recent inspection of that plant ended 2024-07-25 and was classified VAI.
Corvale East has 6.6 days of 5 mg/mL 10 mL vials on hand; Corvale General has 18.6 days.
The top-ranked option is to transfer 27 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East, leaving the sender with 14 days and the receiver with 12 days.
Alternate manufacturers include Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (plant last inspected VAI 2024-03-21) and NorthStar RxLLC (plant last inspected VAI 2022-10-29).

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
